question: The elements needed for magic: 1. Preparation of the needed mana, 2. Proper mental image of the magic to be used, 3. Enough basic ability with your gate to activate the magic in the first place; what happens when you try to activate magic when each one of those is lacking?
answer: It comes out your butt. Just kidding. It simply doesn’t activate. It’s the same thing as how, with the conditions you gave, nothing will happen when you shout “Kamehameha!”. It seems you don’t have enough mana to fire a “Kamehameha”.
